noDevice.title: No device selected
noDevice.body: Connect a device or start an emulator to manage its apps.

single.before: All files, accounts, databases and settings of
single.after: on {{device}} will be deleted. This can't be undone.

clearData.many: All files, accounts, databases and settings of {{count}} apps on {{device}} will be deleted. This can't be undone.

disable.user: The app disappears from the launcher and stops running until you enable it again. Its data is kept.
disable.system: Disabling system apps can break other apps or system features. You can enable them again here at any time.

uninstall.user_one: The app and its data are removed from {{device}}.
uninstall.user_other: The apps and their data are removed from {{device}}.
uninstall.system: System apps are removed only for the current user on {{device}}; the factory copy stays on the device and can be restored.

extract.pickFolder: Choose where to save the APKs

drop.title: Drop to install on {{device}}
drop.hint: .apk · .apks · .xapk — or choose more devices after drop

install.notPackage: Only .apk, .apks and .xapk files can be installed.
install.oneAtATime: Installing the first package; drop the others one at a time.
install.title: Install {{name}} {{version}}

option.bypassLowTargetSdk: Allow a very old target SDK

installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_ALREADY_EXISTS: The app is already installed. Reinstall it and keep its data?
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_INVALID_APK: The file is not a valid APK.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_INVALID_URI: The device couldn't read the uploaded file.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE: Not enough free storage on the device. Free some space and try again.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PACKAGE: A package with this name already exists.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_NO_SHARED_USER: The shared user this app asks for doesn't exist.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE: The installed version ({{version}}) is signed with a different key. Uninstall it first — its data will be lost.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_SHARED_USER_INCOMPATIBLE: The app's shared user is signed differently from apps already installed.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: The app needs a shared library this device doesn't have.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_DEXOPT: The device couldn't optimize the app's code.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_OLDER_SDK: This device runs an Android version older than the app supports. {{detail}}
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER: Another app already uses one of this app's content provider authorities.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_NEWER_SDK: The app requires an older Android version than this device runs.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_TEST_ONLY: This is a test-only build (android:testOnly). Allow test-only packages to install it.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_CPU_ABI_INCOMPATIBLE: The app's native code doesn't support this device's CPU.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS: The app has no native libraries for this device's CPU (e.g. an arm-only app on an x86 emulator).
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_FEATURE: The device lacks a hardware feature the app requires.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_VERIFICATION_FAILURE: Package verification rejected the app (Play Protect or a device policy).
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_VERIFICATION_TIMEOUT: Package verification timed out. Try again.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_PACKAGE_CHANGED: The package changed during installation. Try again.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION: The app declares a permission another installed app already defines.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE: The installed version ({{version}}, code {{code}}) is newer than this file. Allow a downgrade? App data is kept.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED: The device blocks installs over USB. Enable "Install via USB" in developer options (MIUI, ColorOS) or confirm the prompt on the device.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_ABORTED: The install was cancelled on the device. Accept the prompt on the device and try again.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_INTERNAL_ERROR: The package manager hit an internal error. {{detail}}
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_MISSING_SPLIT: A required split APK is missing. Install the full .apks bundle.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_DEPRECATED_SDK_VERSION: The app targets an Android version too old for this device (Android 14+ blocks targetSdk < 23). Install anyway?
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_SESSION_INVALID: The install session expired. Try again.
installErrors.INSTALL_FAILED_MULTI_ARCH_NOT_MATCH_ALL_: The app's native libraries don't cover every architecture it declares.
installErrors.INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NOT_APK: The file is not an APK.
installErrors.INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NO_CERTIFICATES: The APK isn't signed. Sign it (e.g. with a debug key) before installing.
installErrors.INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_INCONSISTENT_CERTIF: The installed version is signed with a different key. Uninstall it first — its data will be lost.
installErrors.INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_BAD_PACKAGE_NAME: The package name in the manifest is invalid.
installErrors.INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_UNEXPECTED_EXCEPTIO: The device couldn't parse the package. {{detail}}

permissions.fixed: Set by the system or a device policy
permissions.noneRuntime: This app has no runtime permissions.
permissions.noneInstall: This app has no install-time permissions.
permissions.noneSpecial: This app requests no special access.

network.title: Data usage
network.foreground: {{share}}% of the last 30 days was used in the foreground.
network.vpn: Plus {{bytes}} through a VPN in 30 days (already counted on the network underneath).
network.source: From the device's network stats (dumpsys netstats), kept since {{date}}.
network.noHistory: The device has no network history for this app yet.
network.noUid: The app has no UID, so its traffic can't be looked up.
network.unsupported: This device doesn't print per-app history in dumpsys netstats. Newer Android versions do; older ones need root to read /proc/net/xt_qtaguid.
